decisions.reason: Ending further design revisions does not change the acceptable formats for any proof attachments or working files that are delivered; the source does not establish a replacement format or remove an existing format.

The client ends the project because locked geometry was not maintained, but does not revoke or alter the required Hero V and É accent peak alignment. The alignment rule remains a valid design specification unchanged.

The project-ending decision concerns revision work and failures in the locked V hierarchy and geometry; it does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The source ends additional revision cycles but does not modify or revoke the established common-baseline rule. No candidate attribute becomes obsolete or contradictory.
